LESSON: READING FOR UNDERSTANDING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading 2.8 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Reading strategies • Fluency By th
Topic 2.9: Reading for Understanding
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading for Understanding, part of Reading 2.8 Reading for Fluency (2 lessons) • Reading strategies • Fluency By th in Grade 7 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: what they hear, ● form a reading buddy club to mentor and model reading among peers. 1. What strategies can you use to effectively comprehend a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. highlight words on common areas or facilities found in their locality from a crossword puzzle ( 医院、教堂、清真 寺、面包店、超市、邮局、饭店、肉店),

2. use pictures or drawings to read the location of different areas and facilities in their neighbourhood,

3. take turns reading the location of different areas and facilities in their locality using the location words 对面、后面、附近、前 面 and 旁边,

4. read aloud a simple text and respond to related questions,

5. read short texts on areas or facilities in their neighbourhood and assign the correct picture to the appropriate text,

6. read the location of various areas and facilities while their peers draw

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. highlight words on common areas or facilities found in their locality from a crossword puzzle ( 医院、教堂、清真 寺、面包店、超市、邮局、饭店、肉店),
2. use pictures or drawings to read the location of different areas and facilities in their neighbourhood,
3. take turns reading the location of different areas and facilities in their locality using the location words 对面、后面、附近、前 面 and 旁边,
4. read aloud a simple text and respond to related questions,
5. read short texts on areas or facilities in their neighbourhood and assign the correct picture to the appropriate text,
6. read the location of various areas and facilities while their peers draw

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading for Understanding together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and Problem solving: the learner develops active listening and communication skills when they listen to the

instructions given by their peers and draw maps to various areas and facilities in their neighbourhood.

Values:
Responsibility: team spirit is developed as the learner cooperates with peers to form a reading club.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer mentorship: the learner gets an opportunity to support and learn from peers as they interact in the reading club.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner relates the skills used in giving directions to map reading in Social Studies.
